strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Hariyama Fake Out flinched Urshifu (the Dark attacker) - the right target; my own Fake Out flinched Gothitelle so Trick Room was traded off.

strategy_checks.check: Gothitelle sets Trick Room on the turn it is safe / Helping Hand at a KO threshold
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 chose Trick Room (flinched). T2 chose Helping Hand instead of re-trying Trick Room; the boosted -1 Atk Close Combat KOed Incineroar from 332/332 for exactly 332, so the threshold read was correct, but the room never went up and Gothitelle died that turn. The dossier allows both; the AI took the KO.
pending_decision listed switch_blocked_by ['ability_prevents_escape'] for both actives on T1-T2; only fainting/Flutter Mane (Ghost) got around it.

strategy_checks.check: Ferrothorn Gyro Ball / Leech Seed grinding mode
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Gyro Ball OHKOed Flutter Mane (fast Fairy: 2x, high base power); T4 Gyro Ball at Urshifu again. Leech Seed not used - it attacked, which was better.

strategy_checks.check: Avalugg deployed with Wide Guard / Body Press / Recover
strategy_checks.evidence: T4 Avalanche into Landorus (4x, OHKO from full); it died on T5 before a second action.

protect_ledger.entry: No opponent Protect used (Gothitelle and Ferrothorn carry it). No empty Protects.

engine_notes.note: With one foe left, Muddy Water's legal target list was [0] (self slot) and the battle text printed 'It doesn't affect Tapu Fini...' while the spread move still hit and KOed Avalugg. Driver/target cosmetic quirk, not AI.

cooler: Genuinely nasty: Fake Out into the right target, a trap that showed up in the driver's switch gate, a Gyro Ball that deletes fast Fairies and an Avalanche that punishes a Ground/Flying misstep. Three faints, keep. The room never went up because the AI cashed a Helping Hand KO instead - which is fine, but it means the Shadow Tag + Trick Room identity was never actually seen here; a second look after the rebuild would tell whether Gothitelle prefers the room when the KO is not on the table.
authored_set_legality: No problem; all four sets played as written (Avalugg L84 at offset 2).
